internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across 38 of 39 occurrences the root means literally to drink a liquid, or names something built directly on that act (the drink, the drinker, the drinking-place, the drinking-turn, the manner of drinking). The same word شَرَاب labels a paradisal pure drink and boiling torment-water alike, so the root carries no good/bad charge of its own. The one exception is 2:93 (Form IV, وَأُشْرِبُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ, 'they were made to imbibe the calf into their hearts'), a figurative saturation of the heart with no liquid and no mouth. That single figurative token, morphologically unique and not triangulable against any second Quranic occurrence, keeps the account short of a universal literal identity and caps the strength.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT eating/solid ingestion (contrasted with أكل: يَأْكُلُ… وَيَشْرَبُ 23:33, and the fixed pair كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ at 2:60, 2:187, 7:31, 52:19, 69:24, 77:43). NOT giving-to-drink / irrigating (that is سقى: وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ… شَرَابًا 76:21, نُّسْقِيكُم… لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ 16:66, وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً 47:15). NOT tasting/partaking (opposed to ذوق 78:24 لَّا يَذُوقُونَ… وَلَا شَرَابًا and to طعم 2:249 شَرِبَ… vs وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ). NOT 'water' as a substance (the drink is milk 16:66, honey 16:69, wine 47:15, ḥamīm 10:4/6:70, muhl 18:29; water appears only when named lexically, 56:68). NOT pleasantness/benefit/quenching (بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ 18:29 vs طَهُور/لَذَّة 76:21, 37:46; and شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ 56:55 is drinking that never sates). The 'apportionment/schedule' sense in شِرْب is contributed by context (قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ 54:28; يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ 26:155), not by the root.

reconciliation.rationale: The bridge is not Quran-internally demonstrated (single occurrence, unique form, meaning unrecoverable from any other token). Under the contract this counts as material resistance rather than a certified extension, so it is finalized RESISTANT and drives the MODERATE cap, while remaining coherent with the drinking field (hence PREFERRED overall, not UNRESOLVED).

It is a motivated specialization bridged to the nucleus, so it does not constitute a resistant sub-class and does not itself cap the grade.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Only Form-IV token; figurative 'imbibe the calf into hearts' with no liquid — candidate for a bridged metaphorical extension of the drinking nucleus.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The bridge is not Quran-internally demonstrated (single occurrence, unique form, meaning unrecoverable from any other token). Under the contract this counts as material resistance rather than a certified extension, so it is finalized RESISTANT and drives the MODERATE cap, while remaining coherent with the drinking field (hence PREFERRED overall, not UNRESOLVED).

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B class-structure, C adversarial) all read 39/39 and converged on the literal nucleus and on 2:93 as the sole resistant/uncertain token; C's adversarial cap was adopted over A/B's STRONG grade.
candidate_root_contribution: ش ر ب contributes the DRINKING relation to a liquid — the oral taking-in of a liquid — realized through a transparent derivational family: the act (Form-I verb, maṣdar شُرْب shurb), the beverage/thing-drunk (شَرَاب sharāb), the agent (شَارِب shārib), the drinking-place/source (مَشْرَب/مَشَارِب mashrab/mashārib), and the apportioned drinking-turn (شِرْب shirb). The root fixes only the drinking relation; the liquid's identity (water, milk, honey, wine, boiling ḥamīm, muhl, pure drink), its quality/valence, and the quantity/manner are all supplied contextually, not by the root.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 39 confirmed occurrences (Tanzil verse_text + QAC morphology); 38 denote literal oral drinking or its direct derivatives, 1 (2:93) is figurative.
layer_attribution.derivation: One root nucleus expressed through a transparent 7-way family: Form-I verb (act), maṣdar شُرْب (manner), شَرَاب (beverage), شَارِب (agent), مَشْرَب/مَشَارِب (place/source), شِرْب (drinking-turn), and the Form-IV causative (2:93).
layer_attribution.lexical_class: شِرْب ('drinking-turn') is a semi-specialized nominal but bridged to the nucleus via overt context; it is NOT treated as an independent lexicalized sense; no genuine homonym split is posited.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Valence (لَذَّة/طَهُور vs بِئْسَ/حَمِيم), specific liquid (water/milk/honey/wine/muhl), and rationing schedule are contributed by context and modifiers — held OUT of the root claim, which remains the neutral drinking relation.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 2:93 moved from STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY to RESISTANT (untriangulable Form-IV metaphor → material resistance, MODERATE cap); شِرْب moved from STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY to CONSISTENT (contextual, bridged specialization).
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 2:93:15:2 persists as the sole resistant seam — coherent with but not Quran-internally reducible to the literal drinking nucleus; it caps scope at REPRESENTATIVE and strength at MODERATE and is the standing reopen trigger.

hard_cases.reason: The only Form-IV and only figurative token: 'made to imbibe the calf into the hearts' — non-liquid object, non-oral locus. Its extension from literal drinking to interior saturation is attested by a single morphologically unique datum with no second figurative occurrence to triangulate it Quran-internally, so it cannot be certified as reducible to the literal nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 2:93 is the sole V(IV) token and the sole figurative use in the packet; the absorption bridge rests on one unique datum untriangulable against the other 38 occurrences, constituting material resistance that caps the unified claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_case_representation.rationale: After reconciliation, 2:93:15:2 persists as a genuine RESISTANT seam rather than a certified extension. It is the single occurrence lying outside the certifiable literal drinking account; all other 38 tokens sit cleanly under the nucleus, so the family remains PREFERRED but capped.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A second Quranic occurrence of ش ر ب that is figurative/non-oral (a liquid-image absorbed by a non-mouth receptacle) OR a literal token in which the root itself, without contextual modifiers, carries a fixed valence, a specific liquid, or the giving-to-drink sense — any of which would either promote 2:93 to a bridged sense (raising toward STRONG) or overturn the neutral-drinking-relation nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The Form-IV/figurative space (only 2:93 exists) and the شَرَاب/شَارِب nominal contexts where valence and liquid-identity are set (10:4, 6:70, 18:29 vs 16:69, 76:21; 16:66 vs 56:54); also سقى-adjacent verses (16:66, 47:15, 76:21) to test whether شرب ever encodes provision.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate verse's Tanzil text plus QAC morphology (qac_pos, qac_verb_form, form); check whether the challenged nuance is carried by the شرب lexeme itself or by an adjacent modifier/frame (طَهُور, بِئْسَ, حَمِيم, قِسْمَة, سَقَىٰ).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Attribute contextual/narrative content (reward vs torment, rationing schedule, specific liquid) to modifiers and framing, NOT to the root; do not import classical-lexicon, tafsir, or synonym-list authority; treat morphological form (I vs IV, N vs V) as the anchor for any sense split.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such second figurative token and no root-carried valence/liquid/provision is found, the neutral literal drinking-relation nucleus and the MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grade stand (2:93 remains the lone resistant seam). If found, revise: a triangulated figurative bridge would raise toward STRONG; a root-carried valence/provision would reject the neutral nucleus.

reopen_conditions: If a second figurative or non-oral ش ر ب occurrence is identified that lets 2:93's 'imbibe into the heart' extension be triangulated Quran-internally, reopen to test promotion of the account toward STRONG/UNIVERSAL.

If شِرْب (26:155, 54:28) or مَشَارِب (36:73) is shown to carry an apportionment/benefit sense independent of its context (قِسْمَة, يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ), reopen the شِرْب cluster as a candidate resistant lexicalized nominal sub-class.
If any Form-I token is found where شرب encodes provision (سقى-type) or a fixed liquid/valence rather than the neutral drinking relation, reopen the neutral-nucleus claim.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The literal drinking nucleus survives adversarial testing across all 38 literal tokens with clean distinctiveness against أكل/سقى/ذوق/طعم/مآء, but one occurrence (2:93) resists rather than being refuted, so a full PASSED verdict is not claimed; per contract, when the core holds while some occurrences resist, falsification is recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrence logged.
